events.notes: Viewed sheets0-1 at original detail. Seed2302 remains almost flat in all learned variants despite clear crossed GT;contrast40 mostly reveals broad colored mottle. Balanced retains ordinary seed2309 strong diagonal family,while weak crossings remain mostly missing. Direct-only resembles parent;periodic correction shows more crossings with direction/support defects. All displayed triplet pixels inspected.

Viewed sheets2-3 at original detail. Seed2309 balanced raw/EMA triplets preserve the strong family and still lack the clear crossing lattice;contrast40 does not show a new convincing reconstruction. Absent mesh keeps broad colored residual mottle. Ordinary sky is smooth,building and foliage very close across branches. Neither branch split nor balance resolves missing natural microdetail.

Viewed sheets4-5 original detail. Main coarse fence stays similar. Fine cab left remains mostly erased and right is stronger in one diagonal direction than in the crossing family under both nominal/profile3879 priors. Balanced changes are subtle and do not establish new fine crossings. Organic bird,butterfly and foliage microdetail remains heavily smoothed. ISO100 AHD and JPEG references are qualitative,not exact GT.

Viewed sheets6-7 original detail. ADC constant panels stay perfectly uniform. Dark noisy flats retain broad colored mottle and residual grain. Balanced and spectral-only panels appear close to parent mottle;direct-only changes that coarse pattern. Native ISO6400 flat triplets for all four shown variants inspected;the filter does not make the field flat.

Viewed sheets8-9 original detail. Native ISO12800 flat triplets retain large red/blue patches;balanced and spectral-only do not remove parent mottle. Sloped dark flat also retains colored patches. Mid-gray and bright fields look smooth at their lower fixed display amplification. All variants and raw/EMA triplets on these sheets inspected.

Viewed sheets10-11 original detail. Natural bird crops retain gross shapes but lose branch/feather microtexture. Quiet ISO6400 step triplets show broad red/blue patches despite changed color balance;balanced is not uniformly flat and the bias improvement is not removal of spatial mottle. Ordinary-transform step remains well defined. All four quiet raw/EMA triplets inspected.

Viewed sheets12-13 original detail. ISO12800 quiet balanced and spectral-only triplets remain strongly mottled green/blue;changed DC color does not remove localized false variation. Native narrow-bar quiet field likewise retains large blue patches. Ordinary-contrast step/bar boundaries stay defined. All raw/EMA quiet triplets and branch panels inspected.

Viewed sheets14-15 original detail. Narrow-bar and slanted/striped quiet fields keep localized red/blue/green patches at contrast40 even when balanced shifts the overall cast. Ordinary edge and pattern boundaries remain sharp at their fixed transform. The unchanged broad residual patterns limit the practical quiet-color gain;no hallucination-free result is visible.

Viewed sheets16-17 at original detail. High-noise striped quiet field keeps colored mottle even with balance. ADC bark/raccoon detail looks unchanged across V168 and balanced;sloped-plane ADC panels stay smooth. This completes actual original-detail inspection of all72 figures/18sheets and24 triplets.
